999008199.text:
船の改装も終わったし……
いよいよ……暗黒の氷海に挑戦だね！

localizations.en: The ships have all been refit... It's finally time to challenge the Midnight Sea!
Resna

999008199.text:
暗黒の氷海を案内して生き延びたっていう
漁師のお爺さんからも、貴重な話を聞けましたわ

localizations.en: We even got to hear some valuable stories from the old fisherman who guided people through the Midnight Sea and lived to tell the tale.
Alvina

999008199.text:
それって、以前お婆さんが話してた……
いいんですか？　思い出すのも辛いはずなのに……

localizations.en: Ah, you mean that's the person the old woman mentioned... Are you sure it's okay? Those memories must be painful...
Resna

999008199.text:
これ以上被害を出したくなかッた……
でも、おめェらよ、本気で行くんだろ？

localizations.en: I don't want any more casualties... But you folks, you're serious about goin', ain't ya?
Old Fisherman

999008199.text: だッたらよ、こいつを持ッてきな

localizations.en: In that case, take this with ya.
Old Fisherman

999008199.text:
暗黒の氷海の、入り口らへんの地図だ。
おらの知ッてる所までだけんどな

localizations.en: It's a map of the entrance to the Midnight Sea. Only shows what I know, though.
Old Fisherman

999008199.text:
それだけでも助かります！
ちなみに、この奥のほうにある赤い丸はなんでしょう？

localizations.en: Even that will help immensely! By the way, what's this red circle over here?
Resna

999008199.text:
おらが案内した冒険者たちが目指そうとした座標だ。
何があるかはおらも知らん

localizations.en: Those're the coordinates the adventurers I guided were tryin' to reach. Don't know myself what's there.
Old Fisherman

999008199.text:
それとこッちは星図、星の位置を記した地図だ。
暗黒の氷海じャ、羅針盤が効かねえ

localizations.en: And this here's a star chart—it shows the positions of the stars. Compasses don't work in the Midnight Sea.
Old Fisherman

999008199.text:
迷ったときは星の位置を見て方角を確認するんですね。
教えてくださって、ありがとうございます

localizations.en: So we can check our bearings using the stars. Thank you for sharing this with us.
Janne

999008199.text:
……若いもんが、無事に帰ッてきてくれりャ
それでええよ

localizations.en: ...Long as you young folk come back safe, that's all I ask.
Old Fisherman

999008199.text:
あとは、頂獣レプルガルムだけど……
どんな魔物か、覚えてる？

localizations.en: Now there's just the Apexi Ripplegharm... Do you remember what kind of creature it was?
Bepp

999008199.text:
覚えておるとも。アレは一言で言やあバカでかい狼だ。
６本の脚で氷の上を駆ける

localizations.en: As clear as day. Put simply, it's a massive wolf. Runs across the ice on six legs.
Old Fisherman

999008199.text:
６本脚の狼……
クヴァレルガともまたぜんぜん違う見た目なんだね

localizations.en: A six-legged wolf... That's nothing like Kvarelga.
Izana

999008199.text:
氷で身動きが取りづらいところへ襲ッてきて……
他の船はあの爪で真ッ二つにされたんじャあ……

localizations.en: It attacks when you can barely move on the ice... The other ships got torn clean in half by its claws...
Old Fisherman

999008199.text:
氷のほうは対策してきましたから、
きっと大丈夫なはず！

localizations.en: We've taken measures against the ice, so we should be fine!
Resna

999008199.text: どうせ付けるなら大きいハンマーにすればいいのに

localizations.en: If we're modifying the ships anyway, why not add a giant hammer?
Izana

999008199.text: それだと無駄が多すぎるって話になったでしょ

localizations.en: Didn't we already discuss how that would be too wasteful?
Johanna

999008199.text:
うん、分かってるよ。うぅ……でも……
ハンマーは、ロマンだから……ロマン君じゃないよ？

localizations.en: Yeah, I know. But still... hammers just have that appeal...
Izana

999008199.text: アルビ号は……やっぱりお休みだよね

localizations.en: The Alvie's... gonna have to sit this one out, yeah?
Alvina

999008199.text:
他の２隻に比べて、少し造りが頼りないものね。
でも、ここまでよく頑張ってくれたわ

localizations.en: Compared to the other two ships, its construction is a bit less sturdy. She's served us well up to this point, but we shouldn't push it.
Janne

999008199.text:
神聖国に認めてもらった証の、アタシの初めての船。
……ここまでありがとう、アルビ号

localizations.en: My first ship... You'll always be the one. Thanks for everything, Alvie.
Alvina

999008199.text:
では……暗黒の氷海を越えて果ての大陸まで！
いざ行かん！　やーー！！！

localizations.en: Now then... through the Midnight Sea to World's End! Let's go!!!
Resna
